message: Becky, I always thought FYC were the critics' darlings. And Daisy, it's funny, because Nikki French is the reason for my fondness for Bonnie Tyler's version: I spent a summer on temporary duty hauling cadets around in the backs of 5-ton cargos at West Point, and that summer was when the Nikki French version was big. My comrades and I spent every night drunk at the wretched little pool hall in town, and the two songs on the jukebox that the girls at the bar always played were Bonnie Tyler's "Total Eclipse of the Heart" and Patsy Cline's "Back in Baby's Arms."
